extracted.intended_audience: authors/designers of interactive fiction and choice-driven narratives (including r/WritingPrompts responders)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for designing and evaluating prompt-driven, choose-your-own-adventure style interactive fiction where players make choices that affect narrative outcomes. Emphasizes player agency, branching structure, voice, pacing, and replayability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meaningful Choice
rubrics_metrics.description: Each player choice should have consequences that ripple through the narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choices that don't matter feel like padding; choices that change endings/scenes/relationships matter. Evaluate whether choices produce visible, lasting effects rather than superficial differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authored Constraint with Player Agency
rubrics_metrics.description: The author designs the possibility space; the player navigates within it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quality IF balances structure (you can't do everything) with freedom (your choices matter). Ensure constraints are clear but allow meaningful avenues for player influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Branching with Convergence
rubrics_metrics.description: Use branching structure but avoid exponential growth by converging at key beats and tracking state.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Techniques include bottlenecks (story converges at key beats), state-tracking (the game remembers what you did), and weighted variations (small differences across many scenes). Avoid pure tree structures that become unmanageable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replayability
rubrics_metrics.description: Best IF rewards multiple playthroughs by revealing different sides, hidden content, or complications on repeat runs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design branches and secrets that encourage exploration of alternate choices; ensure later playthroughs feel meaningfully different rather than only cosmetic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice and World
rubrics_metrics.description: Even with player agency, the implied author's voice must be distinctive; world-building and prose style are author-controlled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a consistent moral universe and prose voice across branches; strong world-building helps the IF feel coherent and engaging despite branching.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pacing of Reveals
rubrics_metrics.description: Information should unfold across choices and chapters so the player is always discovering, not waiting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manage when and how revelations occur to sustain curiosity; avoid long gaps where the player has no new information or payoff for choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character Arc Across Branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Protagonist and major NPCs should grow and change even in branching narratives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure character development persists across branches or is meaningfully varied by choice, so characters feel dynamic rather than static placeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Test — Do my choices matter?
rubrics_metrics.description: A direct check: verify that player choices produce meaningful differences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use playtesting and tracing to confirm consequences ripple into scenes, relationships, or endings rather than being cosmetic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Test — Does the world feel real even within the constraints?
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess whether the setting maintains internal consistency and believability despite authored limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for logical coherence, consistent character behavior, and believable cause-and-effect given the IF's rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Test — Does the prose hold up at the sentence level?
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate sentence-level writing quality, clarity, and style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Polish language, rhythm, and clarity because IF often exposes prose in small chunks; weak sentences break immersion quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Test — Are the characters memorable?
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether characters leave a lasting impression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Memorable characters have distinct voices, motivations, and arcs; ensure non-player characters are not interchangeable across branches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Test — Will I want to replay?
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider whether the work motivates additional playthroughs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replayability can come from hidden content, divergent outcomes, or evolving understanding of story elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Test — Does the world have internal consistency?
rubrics_metrics.description: Check for contradictions or unexplained rule-breaks within the game's world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Internal consistency supports suspension of disbelief; track variables and consequences to avoid accidental inconsistencies across branches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Test — Are dead-end branches still satisfying?
rubrics_metrics.description: Even branches that end the story early should feel like legitimate, satisfying outcomes rather than failures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design dead ends to provide closure, insight, or poignant payoff rather than arbitrary punishment; ensure they aren't merely 'wrong' choices.
